mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate reached 3.78% in November 2022, indicating ongoing tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE was 3.6% in November 2022, near historical lows
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST was 1435.0 in October 2022, indicating strong housing demand
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
